svg.title: Sheet A-300 — SECURITY SECTION
svg.desc: Section drawing. Left: a server symbol enclosed by eight concentric layer bands on each side, labelled Layer 1 to Layer 8, standing on a ground line with hatched earth below; dimension reads 8 layers. Right: an elevation of a rack with twenty-two engine slots labelled E01 to E22; dimension reads 22 engines; telemetry enters from the left, alerts and response leave to the right.
